name: General_And_Account_Matched_Plans
description:
The customer first browses general prepaid plans. After receiving
the plans, they request plans matching their account. They provide
CUST1001 when asked for their Customer ID.

After receiving the prepaid account results, they ask for plans
for a different customer. They provide CUST1002 when asked.

Complete the scenario after receiving the second customer's
postpaid plan results.
expectedOutcome:
The customer receives general prepaid plans, then correctly
matched plans for CUST1001 and CUST1002. Account type is obtained
from customer records. The second lookup does not reuse the first
customer's ID or account type.
expectedMilestones: General prepaid browsing routes to TopUpPlan_Query_Agent and retrieves prepaid HTTP plan data.
An account-specific request routes to UserDataPlan and collects the Customer ID.
CUST1001 is looked up and its returned prepaid account type is used to fetch matching plans.
A different-customer request collects a new Customer ID without reusing previous customer data.
CUST1002 is looked up and its returned postpaid account type is used to fetch matching plans.
Postpaid results include the returned premium unlimited offer; completed answers are not duplicated.
